This Amora Heart Crystal Ring features radiant stones and an elegant interwoven design with romantic heart shaped details on a polished silver finished base. A modern, sophisticated fashion ring in a sculptural style, perfect for casual outings, birthdays and elite daily wear. It is pure elegance with clean reflective symmetry and exquisite detail hand finished.

Features:

  • Type: Statement Ring / Fashion Ring
  • Material: Premium Alloy with Luxurious Silver Finish and High-Grade Zirconia Crystals
  • Design: Contemporary bypass style band showcasing a diagonal path of glittering pave-set stones, flanked by two bypass tracks that culminate in delicate pave crystal heart stations
  • Aesthetic: Radiant, Playful, and Sophisticated with Contemporary Romance
  • Size: Adjustable
  • Weight: 10 grams
  • What's in the Box: 1 x Amora Ring
  • Packaging: Elegantly Packaged in Zeesy Jewellery Signature Box

Care Instructions: To maintain the beautiful shine of your jewelry, gently wipe it with a soft cloth after each wear. Avoid contact with water, harsh chemicals, or excessive moisture to preserve the piece's function and plating.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: Is this Amora Ring suitable for daily wear?

A: Yes, the lightweight minimalist design and durable silver finish make it an ideal choice for daily wear, adding a subtle touch of romance and sparkle to your everyday routine.

Q2: What outfit styles pair best with this twin-heart bypass ring?

A: It pairs beautifully with contemporary western wear, casual tees, and formal office blouses. Its crisp silver tone and fluid silhouette make it perfect for standalone style or stacking alongside chic wristwatches.

Q3: Is the material used in this ring skin-friendly for long-duration wear?

A: Our jewelry is crafted from premium high-grade alloy with a smooth silver finish, designed to be lightweight and comfortable for sensitive skin during extended wear.

Q4: How does this specific Amora style elevate my fashion status at events?

A: The combination of an iconic romantic motif with a modern minimalist metal finish is a symbol of contemporary luxury. Wearing this trend/style status statement piece instantly adds a touch of elite sophistication and artistic grace to your overall style.

Q5: What is the delivery time and authenticity guarantee?

A: Delivery across Pakistan takes 3-5 working days. Every Zeesy piece is quality-checked to ensure premium craftsmanship and brand authenticity.

changes.title: Nauratan Rani Pearl Drop Necklace Set
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
The Nauratan Rani Pearl Drop Necklace Set pairs a traditional double-strand faux pearl necklace with statement chandelier jhumkas. Intricate stone detailing and a silver-tone finish make this artificial pearl jewellery set a distinctive choice for Pakistani weddings, Mehndi, Barat and festive occasions.

Traditional Hyderabadi Nauratan jewellery

Inspired by the enduring jewellery traditions of Hyderabad Deccan, this artificial pearl necklace set recreates the aesthetic of traditional fine jewellery using decorative stones and faux pearls. Designed for comfortable festive styling according to Zee.Sy, it can be worn by women of any marital status. Individual necklace and earring weights have not been separately verified.

Discover the heritage and styling ideas in our Hyderabadi jewellery guide.

A returning Zee.Sy bestseller, available in Multi, Red, Pearl and Silver colour options, subject to stock.

Product details

  • Material: alloy, decorative stones and faux pearls
  • Necklace length: 7 inches
  • Earring length: 2.5 inches
  • Total set weight: 180 grams
  • Adjustable thread fastening
  • Includes one necklace and one pair of chandelier jhumka earrings
  • Zee.Sy signature box

How to style your pearl necklace set

Pair this Nauratan necklace with a lehenga, gharara, embroidered saree or pishwas for a traditional wedding look.

Frequently asked questions

Are the pearls real?

No. This set features decorative faux pearls.

Are earrings included?

Yes, one matching pair of chandelier jhumkas is included.

Is the necklace adjustable?

Yes, it has an adjustable thread fastening.

Do you deliver across Pakistan?

Yes. Delivery normally takes 3–7 working days after order confirmation. Cash on delivery is available in Pakistan.

Jewellery care

Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth after wearing. Avoid water, perfume and harsh chemicals, and store separately.
